snippet.title: Arcane Merchant - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Arcane Merchant, a medieval shop keeping managament game developed by Findie Studios. Players will stock and sell goods such as swords, potions, crystals, and more. Set prices and serve the clientele in Arcane Merchant, coming soon to PC (Steam).
